description: Plan shortening (not deleting) of inter-word pauses longer than max_pause_seconds down to a target, respecting sentence boundaries. Returns centered removal ranges, keep ranges, savings and apply routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

frame_rate.description: Timebase used to snap ranges to whole frames; defaults to 30.

max_edits.description: Maximum pauses to tighten (longest first when capped); defaults to 256.

max_pause_seconds.description: Pauses longer than this are tightened; defaults to 1.0.

sentence_pause_seconds.description: Pause length kept after sentence-ending punctuation; defaults to 0.6.

target_pause_seconds.description: Pause length kept after tightening (split evenly around the cut); defaults to 0.35 and must not exceed max_pause_seconds.

word_timeline.description: Caller-supplied word-timed transcript for one Premiere source item. Words must be ordered by start time and bound to the transcript revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp. Different labeled speakers may overlap; same-speaker words may not, even when another speaker is between them.

words.description: Ordered word tokens with source-time boundaries.

name: plan_pause_tightening

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Plan Pause Tightening
